kevin: Heads-up: planning to enable comet-13b-v2 in catalog during 11:00 PT change window. Canary targets: us-west-2 10%, eu-west-1 5%. Proposed fallback order: comet-13b-v1 -> comet-13b-quant -> comet-lite. Please ack blockers.
deploy-bot: scheduled: comet-13b-v2 canary at 2025-02-10T11:00:00-08:00. Auto-rollback on p99>2x or error rate>0.5%.
anya: ack. i'll run regression suite against us-west canary. adding a safety eval (comet-smoke).
li: quick ask on EU behavior: prefer soft preference to v1 unless we see telemetry; otherwise do hard pin.
kevin: agreed soft preference, but manual pin is ok if EU p99 spikes.
deploy-bot: logs:
[11:00:05] started canary comet-13b-v2 -> us-west-2(10%), eu-west-1(5%)
[11:01:20] traffic shifted.
ops-bot: alert: eu-west-1 p99 increased 2.6x at 11:06:12 (ALERT-250210-1106).
anya: seeing same in smoke tests for long-context prompts. reducing eu to 0% and pinning to v1.
kevin: pin EU to comet-13b-v1 now. leave us-west at 10% while we investigate.
deploy-bot: executing: deploy pin --region eu-west-1 --model comet-13b-v1 --reason "eu p99 spike on v2 canary" -> applied, eu routing to v1.
li: collecting traces; early signs point to tokenizer change causing heavier CPU on long sequences.
kevin: action items: li collect traces (ETA 45m), anya re-run reg-suite on us-west (ongoing), infra prep runtime flag to limit tokenizer cache (ETA 90m).
anya: drafting internal release note: "comet-13b-v2: improved coherence on long inputs. EU canary temporarily pinned to comet-13b-v1 due to elevated tail latency; rollout paused for diagnostics."
kevin: reconvene in 1h or sooner if more alerts. :hourglass:
